snippet.title: Sky Runner: Drone Hero - Official Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a look at Sky Runner: Drone Hero in this trailer for this mixed reality action simulation game. Your living room, backyard—even your bathroom—transforms into a high-stakes drone playground, courtesy of Meta Quest 3. Dodge virtual turrets, rescue hostages, and battle fires, all while staying anchored to your real-world surroundings. Sky Runner: Drone Hero will be available on Meta Quest on July 31, 2025.
